question: A 2200 W electric toaster operates at 220 V. The resistance of its coil is:
solution:
**Given:**

Power of toaster P=2200 W.

Voltage of toaster V=220 V

**Formula Used:**

The resistance of the electric R=(V²)/(P)

**Calculation:**

The resistance of the toaster =((220)²)/(2200)\\=22 ohm

**The resistance of the toaster 22 ohm.**
